description: This Java interface defines a contract for enforcing authorization during WebSocket connection establishment in a gateway service. It specifies a method that takes DittoHeaders as input and returns a CompletionStage representing an asynchronous authorization check result.

classes.name: WebSocketAuthorizationEnforcer
classes.description: An interface that enforces authorization rules for WebSocket connections by checking provided headers asynchronously and returning a completed future with updated headers or an exception.

methods.name: checkAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if establishing a WebSocket connection with the given headers is authorized. Returns a CompletionStage that completes successfully with headers containing potentially new information if authorized, or completes exceptionally if not.
